# Ayush Mishra — FullStack Web Developer

> Personal portfolio of Ayush Mishra, a fullstack web developer based in
> Mumbai, India, currently a Backend Developer at Leapswitch Networks.
> Roughly 2 years of professional experience building scalable web
> applications and REST APIs with Laravel, PHP and MySQL, with frontend work
> in JavaScript and React, and current focus on Python, Django and Next.js.

Contact: ayushbm84@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/ayush-sleeping

## Experience

- Backend Developer — Leapswitch Networks (current). Laravel, PHP, Python, Django, MySQL, REST APIs.
- FullStack Web Application Developer — SkillLogic Technologies. Laravel, MySQL, ReactJS.
- Junior FullStack Web Developer — Technicul Cloud LLP.
- Trainee — Anudip Foundation (Java Fullstack) and TNS India Foundation.

## Projects

- LaraBaseX (Aug 2025) — Laravel 12 + ReactJS starter kit that skips repetitive setup work. Laravel, ReactJS (Vite + Axios), Shadcn UI, MySQL, Tailwind CSS.
- WriteOn (Jul 2025) — Blog platform with rich text editing and live updates. ReactJS, Vite, Firebase, Tailwind CSS.
- DailyBuzz (Jul 2025) — Modular news reader fed by NewsAPI. ReactJS, Vite, JavaScript.
- Personal Portfolio (Jun 2025) — This site. Static HTML/CSS/JS on GitHub Pages, content driven by a Google Sheets CMS.
- NFT Ecommerce (Oct 2023) — Angular CRUD application.
- Brija Stream (Sep 2023) — Search-API driven streaming UI.
- JaBri Travel (Jun 2022) — Travel site frontend.

## Technical notes

- Static site: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step, hosted on GitHub Pages.
- Content is edited in a Google Sheet; a scheduled GitHub Action validates it and
  commits plain JSON to assets/data, which the pages read. The browser never
  calls Google.
- Source: https://github.com/ayush-sleeping/Personal-Portfolio
